'''Tor-Ro-Bo Industries''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company that once claimed the resources of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]]. It competed with rival company [[Eeook Corporation|Eeook Mining and Reclamation]] for the planet.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
